scope: Root reviewed Doubao suggestions against actual sources and current user constraints; suggestions are not instructions.

decisions.decision: Only answer-changing ambiguity triggers a recheck; no marginal effect can be correct, so never rewrite the problem just to force complexity.
One decisive refutation and a usable fallback when route choice matters; no mandatory multi-route tournament or keyword gate.
Independent original linear checker, explicit bounds, absolute integrality, original objective sign, no automatic optimality.
Explain evaluation criteria before comparing; unknown is not zero; no universal complete-case deletion or prohibition of genuine structural zero values.
Match evaluation budgets/seeds and metric units; pool squared errors over declared prediction units, not mean fold RMSE. Do not forbid legitimate overlapping-origin evaluation.
Keep unresolved evidence in compact state; a user clarification invalidates old interpretation even with unchanged files. Reuse existing bound brief rather than add another cache system.
Preserve best feasible baseline and fallback. Do not force a complete export pipeline before a Modex strategy handoff.
Check accidental workflow instructions/placeholders in manuscript; legitimate code/reproducibility paths are allowed. No blanket path-rejection script.

forward_handoff_repair: Corrected impossible inequality typo and oversimplified general feasibility domain; compressed repeated sections and separated unrelated audit. Raw executor artifacts preserved.
